Prices, deposits, the guarantee and the founding offer are in test_tiers.json. sample: made-up data for the preview and the full sample report (always labelled Sample data). video: set src to a video file path (for example assets/video/test-walkthrough.mp4) to replace the placeholder. caseStudies: stays hidden while empty; add real ones only, as { project, quote, who, result, link } (no made-up logos, quotes or numbers). who: the Talk to Aki buttons use social.x and social.telegram from config.js.

who.line: I check every product before players see it, and read every report.

faq.a: Players aged 18+ who passed at least two of our quizzes, and accepted the safety and confidentiality rules. Rushed or copied tests are rejected and replaced.

faq.q: What if too few testers finish?
faq.a: We extend the test until they do, or refund the difference. You choose.
About 5 days, a week, or 2 weeks by tier, from the setup call.
Full deposit refund if we decline your project. After that, the guarantee applies.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: A testnet or staging link, test tokens if needed, and a 15 minute call.

faq.q: Can we use our own NDA?
faq.a: Yes, on Standard and Launch Ready. Testers accept it before they start.
